provenance: synthetic teaching cases, not runtime observations
capability: paired synthetic incident analysis and selected bounded negative Runs

cases.task: Place API acceptance,scheduling,container start,readiness and client response in order.
cases.expected: A trace identifies the first missing or failed boundary for each case.

cases.task: Use case A to name one minimal source/configuration check.
cases.expected: Inspect referenced ConfigMap name/key and availability;do not claim the process crashed.

cases.task: Use case B to propose and predict a one-field repair.
cases.expected: Change /missing to the admitted /ready path;then require new Ready and client evidence.

cases.task: Use case C to distinguish deliberate task failure from timeout or image absence.
cases.expected: Task exit2 and terminal Failed condition identify the injected application outcome.

cases.task: Record observation,hypothesis,one change and acceptance condition for one case.
cases.expected: Each claim cites a bounded field/line and object identity;synthetic facts are labeled.

cases.task: State the post-repair evidence and exact cleanup boundary.
cases.expected: Relevant controller/application checks pass and only recorded owned UIDs are removed.
